questions.title: AI pass vs exact zoom
questions.question: Which version of the 4-second Mandelbrot zoom looks better to you?
questions.why: AI styling is on by default for fractalwright videos; if the plain render wins, the default flips to off (--ai becomes opt-in).
look_for: Detail along the set's edge: does the AI version add texture you like, or smear it?
Flicker between frames from 0.0 s (the clip loops 4 times)
Colour: does the palette stay the same?

guess.why: At 512 px and denoise 0.3 the pass mostly adds frame flicker (raw flicker 54 vs exact 69 smoothed) without new structure.

questions.title: Default for video
questions.question: Should AI styling stay on by default for fractalwright zoom, morph, loop and audio videos?
questions.why: Sets the default in fw.py and the README; each AI-styled 12-frame clip costs about a minute of GPU.

options.label: Keep it on by default (--no-ai to skip)
Off by default (--ai to turn on)
Keep on, but try a stronger look first (higher denoise, a prompt flag, Wan video-to-video)

guess.why: You asked for it on; the current pass is too subtle to judge, so a stronger setting is the next test.
